material_law: omega = 1 - kappa0/kappa * exp(-(kappa-kappa0)/(eps_f-kappa0)); eps_f = kappa0/2 + GF/(h*ft)
continuation_coordinate: h0*n0.T*strain(element 8038)*n0; h0 and n0 fixed only in the continuation coordinate, not in the damage law
tangent: analytical derivative of equivalent strain and current Oliver width; active loading/history/cap branches
tangent_verification: 1000 damaging element states, maximum normwise relative derivative error 1.30e-9
step_refinement: independent step_factor=0.5 run from the same accepted restart
scope: Numerical continuation of the proportional illustrative model; no claim of experimental mixed-mode validation.
